request.agency: Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG)
request.subject: Full Disclosure Policy documents posted by the Municipality of Gattaran
request.requestText: Better Gattaran maintainers respectfully request copies of, or links to, the documents that the Municipality of Gattaran, Cagayan has posted under the Full Disclosure Policy: the annual budget, Statement of Receipts and Expenditures, procurement, trust fund, and 20% development fund utilization documents, with their covered periods and posting dates. If a document type has not been posted, please indicate its status.
